ideas.pitch: Real-time campus infrastructure and crowd density monitor using synthetic sensor data and predictive anomaly detection.
ideas.title: CampusPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: It mirrors winning execution patterns like GeoNex-ATLAS by applying monitoring intelligence to physical spaces, which appeals to campus administrators and technical judges alike.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered academic and course dependency graph navigation platform for students to map out prerequisites and graduation requirements.
ideas.title: SBU-Advisor-Graph
ideas.why_it_could_win: It leverages graph intelligence and multi-agent workflows similar to winning systems like Bito and greennovation-ai-platform, offering immediate practical utility for university students.

ideas.pitch: A localized marketplace connecting campus dining excess with student groups and local food pantries using autonomous notification agents.
ideas.title: DiningHallSurplus
ideas.why_it_could_win: It tackles a tangible local problem on college campuses and mimics the marketplace coordination mechanics seen in Dispatch.

ideas.pitch: Gamified energy and resource consumption tracking platform for campus dormitories providing personalized sustainability insights.
ideas.title: DormEco-Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: It builds directly on the personal wellness and recommendation engine architectures that won prizes at events like Hour Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: Automated lecture transcription, flashcard generation, and concept relationship mapping tool optimized for university courses.
ideas.title: LectureInsight-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges at general student-focused hackathons strongly favor polished tools that solve daily student pain points with reliable AI integrations.
